rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying something made a strong favourable impression on you.

example.traditional: 嗰套紀錄片畀我印象深刻。
example.jyutping: go2 tou3 gei2 luk6 pin2 bei2 ngo5 jan3 zoeng6 sam1 haak1

rows.note: Use this when you are impressed by a person's ability, achievement, or character and feel admiration.

example.english: I was really impressed by her for taking care of three children on her own.
example.traditional: 佢一個人照顧三個細路，我真係佩服。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 ziu3 gu3 saam1 go3 sai3 lou6 ngo5 zan1 hai6 pui3 fuk6

rows.note: Use this colloquial adjective for something or someone that is impressively good, capable, or effective.

example.english: You fixed the computer so quickly—you really impressed me!
example.traditional: 你咁快就整好部電腦，真係勁！
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 faai3 zau6 zing2 hou2 bou6 din6 nou5 zan1 hai6 ging6
